`rnnoise-plugin/` is the unmodified complete source archive of
werman/noise-suppression-for-voice tag v1.10, including its RNNoise source/model.
https://github.com/werman/noise-suppression-for-voice/tree/v1.10
The original license files and notices are preserved. Only the LADSPA target is
built; JUCE, LV2, VST and upstream tests are disabled. Build scripts use this local
source with no network download and no CPU-specific AVX requirement.
